title: Kill Stuck Process
description: Gracefully terminate a process and escalate only when necessary.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

PID="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$PID" || ! "$PID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 PID" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Process $PID does not exist."
    exit 0
fi

kill "$PID"
echo "Sent SIGTERM to process $PID."

for _ in {1..10}; do
    sleep 1
    if ! kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "Process $PID exited gracefully."
        exit 0
    fi
done

if [[ "${FORCE:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
    kill -KILL "$PID"
    echo "Process $PID did not exit; sent SIGKILL."
else
    echo "Process $PID is still running. Set FORCE=true to escalate."
    exit 1
fi
